dedupe_keys.name: force data set french open research catalogue of energy 2026 snapshot

description: This data set is a harmonised time-series matrix of the French power system, the 2026 snapshot produced by the FORCE (French Open Research Catalogue of Energy) pipeline. It was published on Zenodo in July 2026 by Yann Allioux and Yannig Goude of Électricité de France, with a contribution from Nathan Doumèche of Sorbonne Université, to solve the problem that French energy data come at different time steps, spatial units and physical units. The FORCE software, published separately under LGPL 3.0, extracts, validates and reconstructs data from the transmission operator RTE, the distribution operator Enedis, Météo-France observations and the ODRÉ asset registries, and adds PVGIS SARAH-3 solar radiation and Copernicus ERA5 and CMIP6 climate data. The snapshot unifies 15- and 30-minute data into a continuous 30-minute matrix, with national load, wind and solar series, a standard and a full imputed version, and a further file from a newer pipeline run. Coverage is France. Files are CSV, about 1.4 GB in total, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost, with source data under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0. Caveats: gaps are filled by imputation, and the period covered is not stated in the abstract. Simulation uses are load and renewable forecasting, grid economics and climate-energy modelling. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
